title: Heats up quickly, tiny hole to pour water in
text:
Heats up quickly, tiny hole to pour water in. I love the job that this thing does but the hole to fill it is extremely small. They should include a funnel in the box. The steam doesn't last very long. I guess it's that way in all machines but it seems this tank must be smaller than the Bissel I have.

It does the job it's called to do. Just be sure to use a funnel and do not attempt to open to fill again until it is cooled down.
